problem: Gross pay in this month's payroll register is $520,000. The bank payment file totals $406,150, and we cannot match it to net pay.

answers.common.decision: Whether the bank file is ready to release; the payroll manager decides when payroll runs.
answers.common.materials: Tax withheld is $83,200 and employee pension deductions are $26,000. Two new starters' net pay of $6,800 is missing from the bank file because their bank details were not set up. One employee appears twice in the bank file, a duplicate of $2,150.
answers.accounting-operations.systems: Our payroll system and the bank payment file, this month's run, standard chart of accounts.
answers.accounting-operations.approver: The payroll manager approves entries and decides when payroll runs.
